BiblicalUsage: Food is the word for meat, cakes, a meal dressed for someone — and all three uses are in the same dark story. In 2 Samuel 13:5 Jonadab tells Amnon to ask Tamar to dress him meat, in 2 Samuel 13:7 David sends Tamar to Amnon's house to dress him meat, and in 2 Samuel 13:10 Amnon tells Tamar to bring the meat into the chamber. A meal made with care, used as a trap.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the food in this story is a warning: even a sister's cooking can be turned to evil when the heart asking for it is already rotten.
